people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

translations.web: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?
translations.bsb: But Obadiah replied, “How have I sinned, that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to put me to death?
translations.kjv: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
translations.asv: And he said, Wherein have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
